claim.span: I'll help you create Splitwise expenses for your monthly cable bills

task_header.task: I get monthly cable bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "cable bill [MM-YY]" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM-YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's cable usage.

In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "cable bill [MM-YY]" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM-YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's cable usage.

The MM-YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's cable usage.

The MM-YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's cable usage.

task_header.task: I get monthly cable bill via email on the 1st of every month for the previous month's usage. I pay for it but its total cost is to be shared equally with my roommates and me. In our Splitwise group, create an expense for each month with a note "cable bill [MM-YY]" and the associated total cost (including my share). The MM-YY refers to the month and year the bill usage is for. Do it only for bills for this year's cable usage.
